_notes: TikTok Business. Required settings keys: privacy_level, duet, stitch, comment, autoAddMusic, brand_content_toggle, brand_organic_toggle, content_posting_method. Use content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST to actually publish (UPLOAD only drafts to inbox and discards all settings + caption). autoAddMusic applies to PHOTO posts only -> use 'yes' for slideshows to satisfy the no-silent-posts music rule (attaches a random commercial track). For VIDEO posts autoAddMusic/privacy_level are discarded; a video carries its own baked-in bg music from make_video.py. video_made_with_ai=true for videos with AI voice. maxLength 2200.
